svg.text: Phase 2 · step 4f · A vehicle's page: tabs, the Overview dashboard, and Setup (decisions #040, #051, #052): two options
Overview starts the per-vehicle dashboard (readiness, coming due, squawks, fuel arrive later). Setup holds details, meters, custom fields, required readings, the group, and archiving.
A · Header and tabs across the top; Overview as dashboard panels; Setup as stacked sections
Tabs without content yet say which milestone fills them (Timeline, Fuel: 6; Maintenance: 7; Documents: 8).
Make Ford · Model F-150 · Year 2021 · Colour Blue
A · Move to another group (preview first) and Delete (type the name)
Only for a vehicle added by mistake: its records go
with it. To keep its history, set its status to
(#051); empty ones say when they fill.
+ Setup keeps every change on one tab.
− Setup is a long page for a vehicle
B · A summary column on the left (always visible); tabs on the right; Setup split into sub-tabs
Setup (B): sub-tabs Details | Meters | Fields | Readings | Group
− Less room for each tab's content.
− Two levels of tabs in Setup.
